summary: A family run prime London lettings and acquisitions offer is a strength, but a form that needs JavaScript and dead social links appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The contact form appears to show 'Please enable JavaScript in your browser to complete this form' and a garbled label 'I help? Email'.
findings.cost: A landlord or tenant who cannot complete the form moves to the next agent.
findings.fix: A simple working form with WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The page title appears to say Knightsbridge Estate Agents while the footer says Westmere Global Property, and the contact email appears on westmereproperty.com while the site is westmereglobal.com.
findings.cost: Mixed names and domains confuse clients and weaken trust.
findings.fix: One brand name and one domain.

findings.problem: The Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube links appear to go to #, and hero and gallery images appear to be blank placeholders.
findings.cost: Dead links and blank images look unfinished for a luxury agent.

findings.problem: Buy and Sell appear in the menu but no sale listings show, only three rentals, and the proof appears to be one line, 'family-run business built over decades', with no reviews or team names.
findings.cost: Empty sections and thin proof lose instructions.
findings.fix: Real listings, team names and reviews.

redesign: Working form, WhatsApp and one brand.
